lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Multiple high-luminance circular pixel clusters arranged in semi-regular vertical columns on the lateral flank posterior to the branchial region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with horizontal spot alignments to form a nodal grid pattern across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal linear feature is visible on the upper third of the flank, characterized by a sharp luminance gradient transition from light dorsal to shadowed ventral pixels.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Notable irregular indentation and potential tissue loss on the posterior trailing edge of the visible pectoral fin.
other_distinctive_markers: Presence of a distinct remora attachment on the ventral-lateral surface near the pectoral fin insertion.
